description: Shows the voltages of up to sixteen polyphonic channels as numbers, and stacks its three inputs into one polyphonic output

inputs.text: The first group of channels shown and passed on; its channels take the lowest positions in the output
The second group of channels shown and passed on; its channels follow the first group's in the output
The third group of channels shown and passed on; its channels follow the second group's in the output

outputs.text: Carries the three inputs stacked into one polyphonic cable, up to sixteen channels in all

notes: the three inputs are packed end to end rather than mixed, and anything past the sixteenth channel is dropped
the display is refreshed a few times a second rather than every sample, so a fast signal shows only the value it happened to have at the last refresh
